summary: Under normal circumstances, the SEI High Yield Bond & Alternative Credit ETF will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in high yield fixed income and, to a lesser extent, alternative credit securities, as those terms. It will invest primarily in securities rated BB, B, CCC, CC, C and D. However, it may also invest in non-rated securities or securities rated investment grade (AAA, AA, A and BBB).
